item.tib: spyi gtsug u 'bar ba'i gsad zlogs 'khrul 'khor dmar nag
item.coloph: li shu bdag gis kyang / man ngag thugs kyi nying khu 'di/ bsam yas khri tang dur khrod kyi gnas su sbas so/ man ngag thugs kyi nying khu 'di/ phyi rabs don du rgyas par shog spyi gtsug u du 'bar ba rin po che tog rgyud las/ rno khol du phyung pa/ bsad zlog 'khrul 'khor dmar nag zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ u ya ag tham/ dkar po sgrab khang gi steng du skor/ nag po lcags ri'i kha la skor/ bse shog ser po rgas med la/ ku ling byir gyi (gyis) bris/ rma gnyan la gtad pa'o/ log lta can la sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gab rgya/ sbas rgya gsang rgya gsang ba'i rgya gsum gyis btab nas sbas so/ rma pom ras bdag po mdzod/ sa ma ya/ gsad ((bsad) zlog 'khrul 'khor dmar nag rdzogs so//
